sources.title: Embeddings | Gemini API | Google AI for Developers
sources.snippet: The latest model, gemini-embedding-2, is the first multimodal embedding model in the Gemini API. It maps text, images, video, audio, and documents into a unified embedding space, enabling cross-modal search, classification, and clustering across over 100 languages. See the multimodal embeddings section to learn more.
